accessibility.ariaSnapshot:
- main:
  - heading "User Activity Tracking" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Monitor real-time user activity and generate reports
  - button "All Users"
  - button "Admin"
  - button "Supervisor"
  - button "Inventory Manager"
  - button "Technical Officer"
  - button "Driver"
  - button "Machinery Operator"
  - text: 🟢 Currently Active Users 1 active
  - table:
    - rowgroup:
      - row "User Role Login Time IP Address Current Activity Actions":
        - columnheader "User"
        - columnheader "Role"
        - columnheader "Login Time"
        - columnheader "IP Address"
        - columnheader "Current Activity"
        - columnheader "Actions"
    - rowgroup:
      - row "Supervisor One (LITRO-SUPERVISOR-001) Supervisor 4/19/2026, 3:48:15 PM (15m) 192.168.1.45 Viewed breakdown report list View Session Force Logout":
        - cell "Supervisor One (LITRO-SUPERVISOR-001)"
        - cell "Supervisor"
        - cell "4/19/2026, 3:48:15 PM (15m)"
        - cell "192.168.1.45"
        - cell "Viewed breakdown report list"
        - cell "View Session Force Logout":
          - button "View Session"
          - button "Force Logout"
  - text: Activity Summary (Last 24 Hours) 2 Unique Logins 8 Total Actions 1 Failed Login Attempts Detailed User Activity
  - textbox "Search by user name or employee ID..."
  - combobox:
    - option "Today" [selected]
    - option "Last 7 Days"
    - option "Last 30 Days"
  - button "Full Log"
  - button "Generate Report"
  - text: User Inactivity Report All active users have activity in the selected period.
